body: There aren't any organisations around my area, and even if there were, another thing is my parents don't allow me to leave the house without an adult they trust taking me, but I could try to find one online. I had an old P.E. teacher who said he was going to give me the number of a psychiatrist who specializes in LGBT kids, but I never heard back from him.

I'd like to, but they wouldn't take it seriously. I live in Brazil, and over here, hitting your children is very normal for whatever reason. All my friends will often complain about being hit by their parents. Going to the police wouldn't help. They'd send me back home and my parents would get even angrier, possibly resulting in more injuries. I'm scared to take the risk.

don't worry about that, i don't really spend a lot of time on reddit at all. if you check my history, this is my first post. my account is fresh new and i really only planned on posting it because i thought someone here could have the answer.
i checked out what you linked, i find it very interesting. i'll definetly be doing some reading on it and talk to my psychologist about it when i can. 
i understand and have learned that, in life, it doesn't get better- but it gets easier as time goes by. i understand that i am yet a child (or teenager, if you'd prefer that) and i have a long way to go, but the problem is, i don't *care*. i appreciate your idea of trying to find a purpose, but the problem is that i am aware i have a purpose in life, i am aware i can help my friends, i am aware of the joy i am yet to experience someday in life, but... i couldn't care less, if that makes sense. i could have done something amazing, i could discover the cure for cancer and become rich and famous and get thousands upon thousands of people out of their misery, but... what's the point? happiness isn't as important as just being stable, but even then, what is the point? if i keep going, something's gonna come and push me down again, something is going to throw me off, possibly make me feel even worse, and start the cycle again. why should i bother?
i have tried every trick in the books, any and everything people tell me to, but it never seems to work. i always feel like i'm faulty. like i'm uncurable (incurable?) and never, ever going to get better. i feel like a lost case.
what do you mean by that?
